acv.quote: It would have been about seventy-five K a year.

header.reason: Diane, the CFO, froze all new vendor projects after a missed Q3. Nobody showed her what the homegrown system cost. Renee blames timing, but Owen's payback number was never built.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with price changes in minutes, not a quarter of work.

line.text: Monetize faster with Stripe Billing. Manage pricing, reduce churn, and grow revenue on one platform

findings.why: Owen, VP of Product, reached out because every pricing change on their homegrown system took a quarter.
findings.quote: every pricing change takes them a quarter

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Give finance a reason billing is urgent, not a nice to have.
findings.why: Renee never spoke to Diane, the CFO. Owen said finance saw the project as a nice to have.
findings.quote: if it isn't on fire, it isn't funded.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Answer the fear of switching: no card re-entry, moving in stages.
findings.why: Against doing nothing, Owen asked about keeping landlords' cards and moving in stages. His engineering lead feared renewal season.
findings.quote: we don't touch billing before renewal season.

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Cut 'grow revenue' for billing and lead with the price-change demo.

line.text: Financial infrastructure to grow your revenue

findings.why: Owen rejected Renee's revenue pitch, but the demo of changing a price in a few clicks excited him.
findings.quote: we're not trying to grow revenue with billing

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a payback story from a company that replaced homegrown billing.
findings.why: Owen got the general ROI deck but needed his own number for Diane, and someone who had done it.
findings.quote: I can't get this past Diane without a number that's ours.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Describe homegrown billing as 'a tax on the roadmap'.
findings.why: Owen used this phrase for his own problem, and it frames the cost in product time, not revenue.
